approach: I use AI where it measurably improves the quality of my work, and avoid it where it would compromise judgment, voice, or client trust. My philosophy is that AI is a tool, not a replacement for the human expertise my clients are paying for. I disclose AI use when it's more than incidental, and I apply the same quality standard to AI-assisted work as to work I do by hand. What clients are buying from me is judgment, experience, and accountability — AI doesn't provide any of those.

privacy.meaning: Client data, internal documents, and personally identifiable information never enter a third-party AI tool without explicit permission. I anonymise or generalise whenever practical.
privacy.why_it_matters: My clients share information in good faith. Funneling it through opaque third-party systems violates that trust and exposes them to breach risk I can't control.

fairness.meaning: I actively check AI outputs for biased assumptions, especially when they touch people — hiring, evaluation, content about groups, or service recommendations.
fairness.why_it_matters: AI inherits bias from training data. If I ship unchecked outputs, I'm amplifying those biases on my clients' behalf without their knowledge.

transparency.meaning: I disclose when AI assistance is more than incidental — for example, when I use it to generate, analyse, or substantially transform content a client will see.
transparency.why_it_matters: Clients hire me for human judgment. Hiding AI use misrepresents what they're paying for and damages trust when discovered.

accountability.meaning: I am responsible for every output that leaves my desk, regardless of how it was produced.
accountability.why_it_matters: AI mistakes are still my mistakes. Clients can't audit the tool; they can only audit me.
review_process: Every AI-assisted draft gets a full human edit pass before delivery.
For factual claims, I cite or verify from a non-AI source.
checkpoints: Post-draft review against the client brief.
Final read-through specifically for hallucination or fabricated citations.
documentation: I keep a private log of which tools were used on which deliverable.
ownership: All IP remains with the client unless contractually agreed otherwise.

quality.meaning: AI speeds up drafting and research, but the ceiling for quality is set by human judgment, not by the model.
quality.why_it_matters: Clients don't pay for fast — they pay for good. AI that undermines quality defeats the point.

phases.name: Discovery and briefing
use_ai_for: Summarising public background material on a client's industry
Generating a starter list of questions to ask
non_negotiables: Client IP never enters a third-party tool
phases.why_this_matters: The framing of the engagement sets everything that follows. This phase demands my judgment, not a model's.

phases.name: Drafting
never_use_ai_for: Writing final client-facing prose without heavy editing
Generating claims that will be attributed to me or the client
non_negotiables: Every AI-touched paragraph gets a full edit pass
phases.why_this_matters: Voice and accuracy are the product.

phases.name: Review and delivery
never_use_ai_for: Deciding what to cut or keep
Assessing whether the work meets the brief
non_negotiables: No AI-generated text is delivered without human review
Clients are told when AI was used in any substantive way
phases.why_this_matters: Delivery is where accountability shows up. The work must be defensible as mine.

approved_tools.name: Claude
approved_tools.purpose: Drafting assistance, structural outlines, code review
approved_tools.rationale: Good at long-form reasoning; clear safety posture.

approved_tools.name: Grammarly
approved_tools.rationale: Incidental use; does not need per-project disclosure.

client_permission_note: I ask for explicit written permission before entering any client material into a third-party AI tool, even for prompt context.
tool_selection_criteria: Privacy posture (training opt-out, data retention), model quality, provenance, and whether the vendor has a credible responsible-AI track record.
review_frequency: quarterly, and after any challenging engagement
subcontractor_clause: Anyone subcontracting with me is required to follow these guidelines.
